name: Pride Lands
description: Become a lion of the savanna. Hunt for strength, defend your pride, roar down rival packs and rise through twelve cinematic missions.

name: Avengers Arena
description: Four heroes. A rooftop tournament. Master combos, choose a combat perk and climb twelve increasingly demanding battles.

name: Iron Flight
description: Take flight above the city. Weave through rings, fight drones and face skyborne bosses with your chosen suit module.

name: Monterra Wilds
description: Explore a living 3D island. Befriend elemental creatures, evolve your team and challenge six powerful guardians.

name: Candy Pop
description: Glossy candies, layered crystal jelly and colourful recipes. Make clever combos across six delicious worlds.

name: Chikoo & Bunty: Mischief Chase
description: Race through sunlit streets. Jump hurdles, slide under banners and dash for laddoos in a three-lane chase.

name: Dragon Keep TD
description: Protect the Dragon Crystal. Place, upgrade and combine three tower types across four winding battlefields.

name: Ghost Village
description: Defend the moonlit shrine with a team of three ninjas. Switch leaders, combine abilities and face spectral bosses.

name: Iron Citadel
description: Enter a 3D industrial fortress. Find keycards, manage ammunition and defeat robot wardens on your way to the core.

name: World Strike
description: Fight through a 3D tactical outpost. Use cover, change weapons and time your EMP to survive escalating enemy waves.
